title.narrative: Bangasamoro Normalisation WB Trust Fund

description.narrative: The objectives of the Trust Fund are to assist: (i) the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) former combatants and their communities to achieve their desired quality of life in a peaceful and inclusive manner; and (ii) in the development of the six previously acknowledged MILF camps with the end view of transforming these areas into peaceful and productive communities.
